project.name: AI Native Harness Overlay
project.summary: Repository-owned workflow control plane for Agent context, gates, Skill routing, verification, and recovery.

static: node --check scripts/harness/lib/skill-routing.mjs && node --check scripts/harness/lib/context.mjs && node --check scripts/harness/lib/context-guard.mjs && node --check scripts/harness/cli.mjs && node --check scripts/harness-check.mjs

node --check scripts/harness/lib/skill-routing.mjs && node --check scripts/harness/lib/context.mjs && node --check scripts/harness/lib/context-guard.mjs && node --check scripts/harness/cli.mjs && node --check scripts/harness-check.mjs

testDataCleanup.reason: Harness tests run in isolated temporary Git repositories and create no shared test data.

rollback: Use git revert on the focused implementation commit recorded in the Sprint verification report.

notes: 本文件保存机器需要执行的验证事实。本项目是纯 CLI Overlay，没有对外 API 或数据库，因此不保留 SPECS/api.md、SPECS/database.md，commands.contracts 为空。project.name、project.summary 必填；commands.quick.static 和 commands.quick.test 至少各登记一条真实命令；full 组为空时回退到 quick。criticalUserPaths 的 verify 使用 { mode: command, command }，人工路径使用 { mode: manual, instructions, evidence }。recovery.testDataCleanup 使用 { mode: command, command } 或 { mode: none, reason }。verification 控制报告位置、有效期、超时和工作区指纹；workspaceFingerprint 设为 none 时必须在 notes 说明等价审计方式。
